说"核能绝对危险"或"绝对安全"，为什么都不够严谨？

Why are both "nuclear is absolutely dangerous" and "absolutely safe" imprecise?

核电几乎不排 CO₂，但存在事故、乏燃料处置与成本问题；严谨的说法是"在严格监管下，它是低碳但需谨慎管理"的能源，而非非黑即白。
Nuclear emits almost no CO₂ but carries accident, waste and cost issues; precisely, under strict regulation it's a low-carbon yet carefully-managed energy—not black-and-white.

"多种树就能抵消所有碳排放"，为什么是错的？

Why is "just plant trees to offset all emissions" wrong?

树木固碳慢、容量有限，且火灾病虫害会把它吐回大气；它只能补一部分，不能替化石排放"买单"，减源仍是最根本的一步。
Trees store carbon slowly with limited capacity, and fire or pests return it to air; they cover only part, can't "pay" for fossil emissions—cutting sources remains fundamental.

#植树抵消 #局限 #减排优先

"纸杯比塑料瓶更环保"为什么不能一刀切？

Why can't we simply say "paper cups are greener than plastic bottles"?

纸杯常含塑料淋膜、生产耗水耗能，回收也难；塑料瓶虽难降解却可高值回收。谁更优要看用量、回收率与全程排放，而不是材质名字。
Paper cups often have plastic lining and cost heavy water-energy to make, and are hard to recycle; bottles degrade poorly yet recycle at high value. Which wins depends on use, recovery and full-chain emissions, not the material name.

#纸杯 #塑料瓶 #全链比较

"可回收"标签，为什么不等于"一定被回收"？

Why doesn't a "recyclable" label mean "definitely recycled"?

可回收只是"技术上能"，还要看本地有没有回收线、脏不脏、值不值钱；很多塑料因混合材质或没分拣，最后仍进了填埋或焚烧。
"Recyclable" only means technically possible; it also needs local facilities, clean material and market value. Many plastics, mixed or unsorted, still end in landfill or incineration.

#可回收 #误区 #分拣

"纯天然=环保"这个说法，为什么是个误区？

Why is "natural = eco-friendly" a myth?

天然物质也可能有毒、毁林或高耗水，比如野生植物贸易会掏空山林；是否环保要看来源、用量和全程影响，而非"天然"二字。
Natural substances can be toxic, deforestation-driving or water-hungry—wild plant trade empties forests. Eco-friendliness depends on source, amount and full impact, not the word "natural".

#纯天然 #误区 #全程影响

"保护生物多样性就是保护动物"，为什么太片面？

Why is "biodiversity protection = protecting animals" too narrow?

多样性包含基因、物种和生态系统三层，植物、真菌、微生物和栖息地同样关键；没了土壤生物和植被，动物也无处安身。
Diversity spans genes, species and ecosystems; plants, fungi, microbes and habitats matter too. Without soil life and vegetation, animals have no home.
